title: WHEP source
description: Which WebRTC stream to watch, and where to reach it from.

endpoint.title: WHEP endpoint
endpoint.description: The URL of the stream to watch. It looks like https://example.com/whep/<stream>.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: Sent as an Authorization: Bearer header. Leave empty for an endpoint that wants no authentication.

stun_server.title: STUN server
stun_server.description: How the receiver learns its own public address. stun://host:port. Leave empty to use the element's default.

turn_server.title: TURN server
turn_server.description: A relay for when the two ends cannot reach each other directly. turn://user:password@host:port, or turns:// for TLS.

timeout_secs.title: Endpoint timeout
timeout_secs.description: How long to wait for the endpoint to answer the POST. 0 waits forever.
